definitions.explanation: A substance used to color fabric, yarn, or other materials. Can be natural (from plants, insects) or synthetic (chemical).

examples.japanese: ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{染料|せんりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{染|そ}めた→染める：04253_someru⟧⟦{布|ぬの}→布：01489_nuno⟧。
⟦{植物|しょくぶつ}→植物：03248_shokubutsu⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{染料|せんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}す→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧。
⟦{藍|あい}→藍：20100_ai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{古|ふる}く→古い：00488_furui⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{使|つか}われて→使う：00473_tsukau⟧きた{染料|せんりょう}だ。
examples.english: Indigo is a dye that has been used in Japan since ancient times.

notes:
{染料|せんりょう} refers to substances used to color fabrics, yarn, and other materials. The kanji combine {染|せん} (to dye) + ⟦{料|りょう}→料：28172_ryou⟧ (material/agent).

TYPES:
- ⟦{天然|てんねん}→天然：03560_tennen⟧{染料|せんりょう}: natural dye (from plants, insects)
- ⟦{合成|ごうせい}→合成：12027_gousei⟧{染料|せんりょう}: synthetic dye (chemical)
- ⟦{食用|しょくよう}→食用：25328_shokuyou⟧{染料|せんりょう}: food coloring

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {染料|せんりょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{染|そ}める→染める：04253_someru⟧: to dye with a coloring agent
- {染料|せんりょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}り{出|だ}す→取り出す：04220_toridasu⟧: to extract dye

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{顔料|がんりょう}→顔料：19796_ganryou⟧: pigment (insoluble particles mixed into a medium; dyes dissolve)
- ⟦{着色料|ちゃくしょくりょう}→着色料：19751_chakushokuryou⟧: coloring agent (broader term, includes food coloring)
- ⟦{塗料|とりょう}→塗料：24548_toryou⟧: paint, coating material
